Was 30 um. Two independent sources put it near 39: a sieve run against a micron-dialled grinder, and per-brew-method tables where the C3 needs ~1.2x fewer clicks than the C2 for the same grind, which makes its step ~1.2x coarser than the C2's corroborated 33 um.

Was 23 um over 0-60. Timemore's own table gives 29 um per click for the E&B burrs this model carries, and a converter that models the dial as three notches between numbers implies 9.66 um per notch — the same 29 um per numbered click. Ten clicks per rotation, three rotations end to end.
